messages.author: 4fc091db8fcc43c3
messages.subject: Modify R output in latex
parts:
Using the default "latex" render, is there a way I can wrap the R
output in an "Soutput" environment?

I tried this:

knit_hooks$set(output=function(x, options) str_c("\\begin{Soutput}\n",
x, "\\end{Soutput}\n"))

But it doesn't seem to do anything.

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Modify R output in latex
parts:
Let me paste your own answer here in case other people had the same
question. And I need to add one point that the development version has
an improvement on the hooks in that you can set up hooks outside the
Rnw file.


On Fri, Jan 20, 2012 at 12:57 PM, Kevin Wright <kw....@gmail.com> wrote:
> Ah, I got it. I needed to put my settings inside the Rnw file instead of
> setting them at the R prompt.
>
> <<>>=
> knit_hooks$set(output = function(x, options) {
> paste('\\begin{Soutput}\n', x, '\\end{Soutput}\n', sep = '')
> })
>
>
> --
> Kevin Wright
>
